Hello.title: Hello
Hello.description: I’m Grigory, a software engineer focused on backend systems, architecture, and infrastructure — from the first design decisions to deployment and production support.

description.1: I am a Full-Stack Developer with nearly five years of commercial experience. My primary focus is backend development, application and infrastructure architecture, and the full development lifecycle — from data modeling and API design to deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
description.2: My core stack includes FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. I design microservice-based systems using DDD and Clean Architecture principles and work with Docker, Nginx, Ansible, and CI/CD. I care not only about delivering functionality, but also about building solutions that are clear, maintainable, and ready to evolve.
description.3: Alongside my work as a developer, I write research papers in the field of distributed systems. I am also a first-place winner of the LCT Hackathon 2025 and a third-place winner in 2024.
